blocks.text: I am out all day next Tuesday for my exam, so I would like to trade phone coverage with you. You would take my Tuesday morning, and I would take your Thursday afternoon. I have also moved our Wednesday check-in to Thursday morning. That gives me a day back in the office before we sit down, and I will come to it better prepared.
If either change does not work for you, tell me today and we can settle on something else before the weekend. I have not touched the calendar yet, so nothing will need undoing.
